registry.name: Pemerintah Kabupaten Banyuwangi geospatial portal (BAGOS), with ATR/BPN BHUMI as the national cadastral lead
registry.scope: BAGOS is an official Banyuwangi municipal WebGIS and WFS/WMS portal. It exposes thematic and administrative layers, but the inspected catalog and capabilities did not evidence a cadastral parcel layer. ATR/BPN BHUMI is the relevant national land-information custodian and public viewer.

queries.query: Banyuwangi official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Indonesia
queries.result: First-party results identified BAGOS, the official Banyuwangi geospatial portal, and ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS. BAGOS documents a municipal WebGIS and layer catalog; BHUMI documentation describes open land-parcel map concepts and the ATR/BPN cadastral custodian. No first-party Banyuwangi parcel feature response was established.

queries.query: Banyuwangi peta bidang tanah kadaster resmi ATR BPN GIS
queries.result: Hasil penelusuran sumber resmi menemukan BAGOS Pemerintah Kabupaten Banyuwangi, SITARU Banyuwangi, serta BHUMI/ATLAS ATR/BPN. BAGOS menyediakan katalog layer dan layanan WebGIS; dokumentasi BHUMI menjelaskan layer bidang tanah dan identitas NIB, tetapi tidak ditemukan respons fitur bidang tanah anonim yang terikat titik Banyuwangi.

registryEvidence.custodianQualification: BAGOS establishes a local municipal geospatial service custodian; ATR/BPN establishes the national land/cadastral custodian. Neither inspected public route yielded a qualified Banyuwangi parcel ID-plus-geometry response.
registryEvidence.observedClaims: BAGOS presents itself as Banyuwangi's digital WebGIS and geospatial-data portal. BHUMI/ATLAS documentation describes land-parcel layers and public spatial access, with official reliance subject to ATR/BPN information procedures.

service.name: BAGOS Banyuwangi WebGIS / GeoServer WFS-WMS
service.sourceCustodian: Pemerintah Kabupaten Banyuwangi for BAGOS; ATR/BPN for national cadastral data
service.requestOutcomes: The BAGOS viewer returned JavaScript/configuration successfully. variables.js exposed EPSG:4326, a Banyuwangi map extent, and the /peta/banyuwangi/wms route. WMS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200 and 253 named layers; no cadastral parcel/bidang tanah layer was identified. WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200, advertised application/json, and the bounded PBB thematic request returned HTTP 200 with one MultiPolygon feature, but this is a PBB realization thematic layer rather than a proven cadastral parcel source. The exact-point bounded PBB request returned HTTP 200 with zero features. No parcel geometry is retained.

nativeIdFields: GeoServer feature id for the tested PBB layer, not accepted as a cadastral identity

nativeFieldMapping.geometry: GeoJSON geometry returned by WFS for the tested thematic layer; not retained
nativeFieldMapping.id: Feature id observed, not proven to be a cadastral parcel identity

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: WFS capabilities advertised urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326; variables.js configured EPSG:4326
schemaAndCrs.geometryType: MultiPolygon observed in the tested PBB thematic response; no cadastral parcel geometry established

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity only if source-proven

exactPointCheck.method: Preserved exact WUP point [-8.21557023643141, 114.365161016598] in latitude/longitude order; used only as the center of a bounded WFS bbox and did not shift it.
exactPointCheck.result: The tested PBB thematic layer returned zero features in the small bbox. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.

uncertainty: BAGOS is a local official WebGIS/WFS/WMS custodian, but its published layer set did not expose a qualified cadastral parcel layer.
The tested PBB polygon layer is not treated as cadastral parcel data and its source-specific attributes and geometry were not retained.
BHUMI/ATLAS remains a national cadastral lead; no anonymous Banyuwangi parcel query response was qualified from its public pages.

The exact-point thematic-layer miss does not establish citywide absence; no coordinate shift, login, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime readiness.
